content:
A uniformly chosen point lies in the shaded sector with probability equal to its area divided by the area of the whole disk.

Since the shaded region is a sector, its area is proportional to its central angle. The lower half of the disk has angle \(180^\circ\). The unshaded angles in that half are

\[
30^\circ+65^\circ+40^\circ=135^\circ.
\]

Thus the shaded sector has central angle

\[
180^\circ-135^\circ=45^\circ.
\]

Therefore,

\[
P(\text{shaded})=\frac{45^\circ}{360^\circ}
=\frac{1}{8}.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac18}
\]
